description: User moves money to or from a family member (remittance, family support). Logged as a transaction. NOTE: the app currently drafts this as INCOME (recipient side) in CognitionFacade, but real user phrasings are predominantly OUTGOING ('sent money to parents'). Recipient-side drafting should be reconciled with direction detection during app adoption.
